name: N Candles v3
summary: N Candles v3 is a candlestick pattern-based EA that identifies trading opportunities by analyzing a configurable number of consecutive candles (N candles) for specific pattern formations. It generates entry signals when the pattern matches predefined bullish or bearish criteria and executes trades accordingly. The EA operates systematically based on candle structure rather than traditional technical indicators.
summary_zh: N Candles v3 是一个基于K线形态的EA，通过分析可配置数量的连续K线（N根K线）来识别特定的形态模式并产生交易信号。当K线组合匹配预定义的看涨或看跌条件时，EA会自动入场交易。该EA完全基于K线结构进行系统化交易，而非依赖传统技术指标。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是识别由N根连续K线组成的特定形态模式，当形态满足预设条件时产生入场信号。入场条件基于连续K线的开收高低关系判断趋势方向，例如连续阳线看涨或连续阴线看跌。出场条件可能包括固定止盈止损或形态反转信号。仓位管理方面，从文件名来看该EA未明确体现复杂的仓位管理逻辑，可能使用固定手数或简单比例。资金管理依赖于参数配置，但缺乏明显的动态调整机制。整体策略依赖于K线形态的统计优势，但在震荡行情中可能频繁出现假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is to identify specific candlestick patterns formed by N consecutive candles, generating entry signals when the pattern meets predefined conditions. Entry conditions are based on the open-close-high-low relationships of consecutive candles to determine trend direction, such as consecutive bullish candles for uptrend or bearish candles for downtrend signals. Exit conditions likely include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or pattern reversal signals. Position sizing appears to use fixed lot sizes or simple proportional methods without sophisticated dynamic adjustment. Money management relies on parameter configuration but lacks obvious adaptive mechanisms. The overall strategy depends on the statistical edge of candlestick patterns, but may generate frequent false signals in ranging or choppy markets.

parameters.name: N_Candles
parameters.description: 用于形态识别的K线数量
parameters.description_en: Consecutive candle count for same-direction detection

parameters.name: Magic_Number
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 基于K线形态的策略直观易懂，逻辑清晰
N根K线的可配置参数提供了灵活性，可适应不同市场环境
纯价格行为驱动，避免了指标滞后的问题
pros_en: Candlestick pattern-based strategy is intuitive and easy to understand with clear logic
Configurable N candles parameter provides flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Pure price action driven, avoiding the lag issue common with technical indicators
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理机制
未明确包含趋势过滤机制，可能在逆势中频繁开仓
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals in ranging or choppy market conditions
Lacks dynamic position sizing and sophisticated money management mechanisms
No explicit trend filter mechanism, may frequently open positions against the prevailing trend
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线或ADX）以避免逆势交易
加入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和波动率调整手数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as moving average or ADX) to avoid trading against the prevailing trend
Implement dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on account equity and market volatility

risk_points: 缺乏趋势过滤可能在震荡市中频繁亏损
固定仓位管理未考虑账户风险比例
risk_points_en: Lack of trend filter may cause frequent losses in ranging markets
Fixed position sizing does not account for account risk ratio
